title: The astrological twelve-house tarot spread
description: A guide to the twelve-house tarot spread: how the wheel layout works, what each of the twelve positions covers, and how to read it without astrology.

scenes.headline: The astrological twelve-house tarot spread
scenes.caption: The twelve-house tarot spread places twelve cards in a ring, one for each area of life. It borrows astrology's structure but needs no knowledge of astrology.
scenes.vo: The twelve-house tarot spread places twelve cards in a ring, one for each area of life. It borrows astrology's structure but needs no knowledge of astrology.

scenes.headline: Where the layout comes from
scenes.caption: In astrology, a birth chart is a circle divided into twelve sections called houses, each associated with a theme such as home, work or relationships.
scenes.vo: Where the layout comes from. In astrology, a birth chart is a circle divided into twelve sections called houses, each associated with a theme such as home, work or relationships.

scenes.headline: The twelve positions
scenes.caption: Self, money and values, communication, home and roots, then creativity and play.
scenes.vo: The twelve positions. Self, money and values, communication, home and roots, then creativity and play.

scenes.headline: Reading the wheel
scenes.caption: Start by reading each card against its house, and keep it brief.
scenes.vo: Reading the wheel. Start by reading each card against its house, and keep it brief.
